text.en: The uterus lining flows out through the vagina as blood and tissue. It is healthy, not an illness.
text.hg: Uterus ki lining blood aur tissue ke roop mein vagina ke raaste bahar aati hai. Yeh healthy hai, bimaari nahi.

text.en: Usually about two years after breasts start to develop, often between 10 and 15. None by 15? See a doctor.
text.hg: Usually breast development start hone ke lagbhag do saal baad, aksar 10 se 15 ke beech. 15 tak na aaye toh doctor ko dikhao.

text.en: Bleeding usually lasts 2 to 7 days. The total is only a few tablespoons, even if it looks like more.
text.hg: Bleeding usually 2 se 7 din chalti hai. Total amount bas kuch tablespoons hota hai, chahe zyada lage.

text.en: In the first years, periods can come 21 to 45 days apart, and a month may get skipped.
text.hg: Shuru ke saalon mein periods 21 se 45 din ke gap par aa sakte hain, aur koi mahina skip bhi ho sakta hai.

text.en: Keep two pads, spare underwear and a paper bag for disposal in your school bag.
text.hg: School bag mein do pads, ek extra underwear aur pad phenkne ke liye paper bag rakho.

text.en: Tell your mother, father, an older sister, an aunt or a teacher, when it starts or even before.
text.hg: Mummy, papa, badi behen, mausi-bua ya teacher ko batao, period start hone par ya usse pehle hi.

title.en: Using a pad, step by step
title.hg: Pad use karna, step by step

text.en: With clean hands, peel off the paper strip, press the pad onto your underwear and fold the wings.
text.hg: Saaf haathon se paper strip hatao, pad ko underwear pe press karo aur wings sides pe fold kar do.

text.en: Change it even on light days, or sooner if it feels wet or heavy. Longer pads suit nights.
text.hg: Flow light ho tab bhi change karo, aur geela ya heavy lage toh pehle hi. Raat ke liye lambe pads achhe rehte hain.

text.en: Wrap the used pad in paper or its wrapper and put it in a dustbin. Never flush it.
text.hg: Used pad ko paper ya uske wrapper mein lapet kar dustbin mein daalo. Kabhi flush mat karo.

text.en: Wash your hands after each change. Bathe daily; plain water is enough for the vulva.
text.hg: Har change ke baad haath dho lo. Roz nahao; vulva ke liye plain paani kaafi hai.

text.en: School, sport, dancing, cooking and washing your hair are all fine during a period.
text.hg: Period mein school, sports, dance, cooking aur baal dhona, sab theek hai.

text.en: A cycle is counted from the first day of bleeding. Estrogen and progesterone are low, so energy can dip.
text.hg: Cycle ki ginti bleeding ke pehle din se hoti hai. Estrogen aur progesterone low rehte hain, isliye energy down lag sakti hai.

text.en: FSH from the pituitary ripens follicles in the ovaries. They make estrogen, which rebuilds the uterus lining.
text.hg: Pituitary ka FSH ovaries mein follicles ripe karta hai. Yeh estrogen banate hain, jo uterus ki lining dobara build karta hai.

text.en: An LH surge makes one ovary release an egg, roughly two weeks before the next period. The day shifts from cycle to cycle.
text.hg: LH surge se ek ovary egg release karti hai, next period se kareeb do hafte pehle. Yeh din har cycle mein shift ho sakta hai.

text.en: The empty follicle makes progesterone, which keeps the lining thick. Some people notice sore breasts, bloating or mood changes.
text.hg: Khaali follicle progesterone banata hai, jo lining ko thick rakhta hai. Kuch logon ko breasts mein dard, bloating ya mood changes feel hote hain.

text.en: If the egg is not fertilised, hormones fall after about two weeks, the lining sheds, and a new cycle begins.
text.hg: Egg fertilise na ho, toh kareeb do hafte baad hormones gir jaate hain, lining shed hoti hai aur naya cycle start hota hai.

title.en: Period pain: what helps, when to get help
title.hg: Period pain: kya help karta hai, kab help lo

points.en: Heat: a hot water bottle or warm bath relaxes the muscle
points.hg: Heat: hot water bottle ya gungune paani se nahana muscle ko relax karta hai

points.en: Gentle movement like walking, stretching or yoga; rest is fine too
points.hg: Walking, stretching ya yoga jaisi halki movement; zaroorat ho toh rest bhi theek

points.en: Pain relief taken as pain begins; ask a doctor or pharmacist which suits you
points.hg: Dard shuru hote hi li gayi pain-relief medicine; kaunsi sahi hai, doctor ya pharmacist se poochho

points.en: Sleep, water and iron-rich food like leafy greens, dal, chana and eggs
points.hg: Neend, paani aur iron-rich khana, jaise hari patti wali sabziyan, dal, chana aur ande

points.en: Pain makes you miss school, vomit or faint
points.hg: Dard ki wajah se school miss ho, ulti ho ya behoshi aaye

points.en: Usual measures do not help, or pain keeps getting worse
points.hg: Usual upaayon se aaram na mile, ya dard badhta hi jaye

points.en: Mood changes before a period feel unmanageable
points.hg: Period se pehle mood changes sambhal na rahe hon

points.en: Thoughts of self-harm: call Tele-MANAS 14416 or tell a trusted adult now
points.hg: Self-harm ke khayal aayein: turant Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo ya kisi trusted adult ko batao

title.en: Worn outside or inside: your options

points.en: Disposable pads: the easiest to start with
points.hg: Disposable pads: start karne ke liye sabse easy

points.en: Cloth pads and period underwear: cheaper over time, need soap, water and sun-drying
points.hg: Cloth pads aur period underwear: long term mein saste, par sabun, paani aur dhoop mein sukhana zaroori

points.en: Low-cost pads at Jan Aushadhi stores and through ASHA workers in many areas
points.hg: Kai areas mein low-cost pads Jan Aushadhi stores aur ASHA workers se milte hain

points.en: Skip scented pads; fragrance does nothing for hygiene
points.hg: Scented pads skip karo; fragrance se hygiene nahi badhti

points.en: Tampons: use the lowest absorbency you need and change every 4 to 8 hours
points.hg: Tampons: flow ke hisaab se sabse kam absorbency wala lo, har 4 se 8 ghante mein change karo

points.en: Cups: collect blood, last for years, need clean water and a private washroom
points.hg: Cups: blood collect karte hain, saalon chalte hain, clean paani aur private washroom chahiye

points.en: A tampon cannot get lost inside; a doctor can remove it easily
points.hg: Tampon andar kho nahi sakta; doctor use easily nikaal dete hain

points.en: Sudden high fever, rash, vomiting or dizziness: remove it and get urgent care
points.hg: Achanak tez bukhaar, rash, ulti ya chakkar: use nikaalo aur turant medical care lo

title.en: Period red flags: see a doctor
title.hg: Period red flags: doctor ko dikhao

text.en: Soaking a pad or tampon every one to two hours, or passing large clots again and again.
text.hg: Har ek-do ghante mein pad ya tampon poora bheeg jaana, ya baar-baar bade clots aana.

text.en: Bleeding that lasts more than 7 days, or bleeding between periods.
text.hg: 7 din se zyada bleeding, ya do periods ke beech bleeding.

text.en: Pain that stops normal activity. Endometriosis is often dismissed as ordinary cramps for years.
text.hg: Aisa pain jo normal kaam rok de. Endometriosis ko aksar saalon tak normal cramps samajhkar ignore kiya jaata hai.

label.hg: Lamba gap ya period hi nahi

text.en: Periods that stop for three months or more, or no first period by 15.
text.hg: Teen mahine ya usse zyada periods band rehna, ya 15 saal tak first period na aana.

text.en: Infrequent or missed periods, extra face or body hair, stubborn acne or thinning scalp hair. PCOS is manageable.
text.hg: Kabhi-kabhaar aane wale ya miss hote periods, face ya body par extra hair, stubborn acne ya scalp hair patle hona. PCOS manageable hai.

text.en: Heavy bleeding with fainting or a racing heartbeat: go to a hospital straight away or call 112.
text.hg: Heavy bleeding ke saath behoshi ya dil ki tez dhadkan: turant hospital jao ya 112 pe call karo.
